prose.subject: Payment Required: Freight Route Analysis Report
prose.body: Your request for the detailed freight route analysis has been processed. To unlock the full report, please complete the payment of 4228.56 USDC. Once the transaction is confirmed, the document will be generated and available for immediate download. This report includes optimized path recommendations, estimated transit times, and real-time congestion forecasts for your specified corridor. To proceed, send the exact amount to our designated payment account: 0x0c38ab16da6d1bbaf85ad17d8f10cbdd282b5b26. Please ensure you use the USDC standard on the supported network to avoid processing delays. After payment, the system will automatically verify the transaction and release access to the data. If you encounter any issues, check your transaction hash against the receipt in your wallet. The report remains valid for 24 hours after generation, allowing you time to review the strategic logistics data. Thank you for choosing Wexcombe Freight for your supply chain intelligence needs.
